metadata.degree_name: PhD specialising in Augmentative and Alternative Communication
metadata.department: Centre for Augmentative and Alternative Communication

module_catalog.name: Thesis: AAC 990
module_catalog.content: Expert, highly specialised and advanced research, both across the major discipline and with possible interdisciplinary connections. Independent and accountable planning, resourcing, managing of all aspects of the research process, optimising all aspects of processes engaged in, within complex and unpredictable contexts. Use of computer programs for analysis and reporting writing is required, and showing academic and scientific leadership.
